content.label: When I was just normally talking to my friend, it was normal right? Then I shut my phone off. I talked to him for a little bit more. I opened it back up and do you wanna know what I see? Copied and pasted conversation of me and my friend. I didn’t even touch the keyboard or anything it just spy on me friend so yeah that’s why I’m giving this one star, it’s creepy as heck!
